items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a Cohen ring Lambda with residue field of characteristic p the reduction map Z/p^n -> Lambda/p^n Lambda is formally smooth for every n at least one (statement lines 45123-45132). The proof separates the two ingredients: the case n = 1 is formal smoothness of a separable field extension, cited as a characterisation, and the induction step places the ideal generated by p^n, whose square vanishes in the source, so that the cited lifting lemma applies (proof lines 45134-45142). The step that carries the content is the arrangement of the induction, since the lifting lemma needs a square-zero ideal in the source and the author has to note that (p^n) has this property there. Both inputs are same-chapter results, so the card is H2.
